---
name: tracker-connect
description: "Tracker Connect through a configurable external tracker provider"
---

Read `skills/tracker-awareness/SKILL.md` for exact CLI and safety contract.

Confirm the explicit target application repository/project and provider. Do not infer origin or reuse starter IDs. Write .planning/tracking-config.json using tracking/examples/config.github.json after user approval (credentials only through env/helper). Run doctor. Offer import --milestone ID for existing scope. Import makes no remote edits but deliberately resets the local scope snapshot; get approval when replacing existing plans. For new scope, hand off to tracker-sync. Never overwrite existing config without showing the proposed change.
